finding_dispositions.rationale: Treat swallowed worker-side coordination failures as a strongly inferred test-design risk. New workers record wait outcomes for main-thread assertions, so accepted cancellation cannot hide a test timeout.

Add missing API cancellation and serialized-ordering coverage with failing-first observations and bounded cleanup. This duplicates A's coverage observation without increasing the distinct-defect count.
Correct README statements directly invalidated by the repair while retaining the seeded-baseline disclosure and immutable historical records.

Reject inclusion, not the observation: the Exception-only catch is visible in repository evidence, but changing non-Exception BaseException handling belongs to OUT_OF_SCOPE-001 and is not required by the frozen request.
Set the worker Event inside the accepted cancellation decision under the existing lock, and prove the worker observes it. Same defect as B's missing-signal observation.

Requirement 6 covers nested mutable results. Deep-copy the result outside the lock; document identity/copyability limits, test ordinary nested data and explicit copy failure, and do not silently return an alias.
Accept as preservation evidence, not new defects. Keep all five baseline tests and test terminal false decisions, unknown ids, ordinary success/failure, and queued cancellation across both batches.

Condition both worker publication branches on the running state under the cancellation lock. Same defect as A's unconditional-publication observation; never replace this repair with snapshot filtering.
Set the existing cancellation Event as part of accepted queued/running cancellation and add the cooperative-worker observation. Preserve this duplicate signal finding's provenance.

Make terminal publication conditional under the existing lock so cancellation-first stays cancelled and completion/failure-first rejects cancellation unchanged; cover both success and exception branches.
Add consequential cancellation regressions in the same batch as the repair, retaining the original reproducer and unchanged baseline tests. This closes A's P1 acceptance-coverage finding.
